author: Kushal
problem: Read a positive integer D (up to 2 * 10^12) and print the minimum of |x^2 + y^2 - D| over non-negative integers x and y.
bug_description: Inside the loop over nearby candidates i it still uses y, so only y = floor(sqrt(D - x^2)) is tried and y + 1 is never considered.

comments.accurate: Tries each x up to sqrt(D) and the y values near sqrt(D - x^2) to minimise |x^2 + y^2 - D|
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries each x up to sqrt(D) with y = floor(sqrt(D - x^2)) to minimise |x^2 + y^2 - D|
comments.wrong_location: Inner candidate loop verified; check that the x range reaches int(d**.5) for large D
